City of Chicago
                                                                    O2022-2461
                            Office of the City Clerk
                           Document Tracking Sheet



Meeting Date:                 7/20/2022
Sponsor(s):                   Martin (47)
Type:                         Ordinance
Title:                        Zoning Reclassification Map No. 9-H at 2159 W Addison St
Committee(s) Assignment:      Committee on Zoning, Landmarks and Building Standards
                                        ORDINANCE

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO

         SECTION 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, is hereby amended by changing all ofthe C1-1, Neighborhood Commercial
District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 9H in an area bound by:
       North Leavitt Street, West Addison Street, a line 23.60 feet East of and parallel to
       North Leavitt Street, the alley next South and parallel to West Addison Street
to those of a RT-4, Residential Two-Flat, Townhouse, and Multi-Unit Distnct.
       SECTION 2. This ordinance takes effect after its passage and due publication.



Common Address:              2159 West Addison Street




                                                                            Alderman, 47th Ward
